## Tasks

### <a name="publish_el7"></a>`publish_el7`

Publish and activate the EL7 Puppet agent installer on the PE primary

**Supports noop?** false

#### Parameters

##### `el7_extended_support_agent_location`

Data type: `String[1]`

EL7 Extended Support Agent Location. Absolute path to the RPM on the PE primary.

##### `current_package_path`

Data type: `String[1]`

Path to the PE current package symlink

##### `platform_tag`

Data type: `String[1]`

PE installer platform tag for the EL7 RPM

##### `repo_template`

Data type: `String[1]`

EL7 Yum repository template from Hiera

##### `installer_template`

Data type: `String[1]`

EL7 Bash installer template from Hiera

##### `require_gpg_check`

Data type: `Optional[Boolean]`

Require a trusted RPM signature and enable Yum package signature checks. Defaults to true.

## Plans

### <a name="extended_support_agent--publish_el7"></a>`extended_support_agent::publish_el7`

Publish a staged EL7 Puppet agent build on the PE primary discovered in PuppetDB.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `extended_support_agent::publish_el7` plan:

* [`el7_extended_support_agent_location`](#-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--el7_extended_support_agent_location)
* [`require_gpg_check`](#-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--require_gpg_check)
* [`puppet_enterprise_certname`](#-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--puppet_enterprise_certname)

##### <a name="-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--el7_extended_support_agent_location"></a>`el7_extended_support_agent_location`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\/.+\.rpm\z/]`

EL7 Extended Support Agent Location. Absolute path to the RPM on the PE primary.

##### <a name="-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--require_gpg_check"></a>`require_gpg_check`

Data type: `Boolean`

Verify the RPM signature on the primary and require Yum GPG checks.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-extended_support_agent--publish_el7--puppet_enterprise_certname"></a>`puppet_enterprise_certname`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\z/]]`

Target certname. Omit to discover the PE primary in PuppetDB.

Default value: `undef`
